{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values or implausible data
# The minimum age is -1, which is implausible
sentinel_age = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == -1]

# Check how many rows have this sentinel value
sentinel_count = len(sentinel_age)

sentinel_count, sentinel_age.head()"}
